notes.title: NEXT FEST Demo Update 0.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I hope you're doing well.

The latest update for Mystical Tactics is live, just in time for Steam Next Fest! This update brings major gameplay enhancements, new mechanics, and plenty of improvements.

What's New in 0.4?
🔥 Elemental Surfaces – Fire, water, poison, and more now affect the battlefield! Spells and abilities interact dynamically, like fire igniting oil or electricity spreading through water.
✨ New Skills & Magic Class Overhaul – Tons of new abilities, especially for magic users, plus unique spells for each magical class!
⚒️ Blacksmith Rework – The blacksmith now requires gold but lets you enchant or upgrade your gear.
🎁 Level Rewards Adjustments – Small tweaks to improve progression and rewards.
🍾 Consumable System Update – Potions no longer cost Action Points, but each character can only use one item per turn.
⚖️ Balance Changes – Tweaks and fine-tuning across all aspects of the game.
🛠️ QoL & UI Improvements – Better tooltips, improved in-game wiki, and more UI enhancements.
🐛 Bug Fixes – Squashing as many bugs as possible!

I'll continue to update the demo to fix any bugs or issues that come up. Your feedback is invaluable, so keep sharing your thoughts! That said, from now on, my main focus will be on completing the full game, aiming for a release before summer. Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The new demo update (0.3.0) is available, and here is the list of changes :

[list]
[*] Weapons have been completely overhauled. Characters can equip different types that provide various bonuses (and there are hammers too).
[*] To complement this, you can now switch weapons in combat via the item menu.
[*] The attack range is reduced to 1 when a shooter is engaged in melee (this applies to enemies as well).
[*] Other small changes to the combat system (you start closer to the enemies, some status effects have been revised, etc.).
[*] Most melee classes have been reworked with new skills and rebalancing.
[*] New types of items (bombs and darts).
[*] Variants of some basic mobs have been added to increase diversity at the start.
[*] Plenty of small UI/UX tweaks, including tiles with red edges when a character can be attacked there.
[/list]

Once again, I’m looking forward to your feedback on the forum or on Discord. Feel free to tell me what you think about the changes, the balancing, what you’d like to see in the next update, and of course, if you encounter any bugs or strange behavior.

Thank you and have a great day!

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.0 : Quality of life
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The demo for Mystical Conquests got its first big update.

The update includes :
[list]
[*] Controller support (almost full, the only thing not currently supported is renaming the characters)
[*] New tutorials
[*] The bandits now flee after 3 turns instead of 4, but the battles don't end anymore while they are alive
[*] Minor balance changes (the lich has more mobs, ...)
[*] Some minor UI improvements (mainly an indicator when a unit is in overwatch/guard)
[*] Some minor bug fixes
[/list]

If you encounter any bug, you can report it on the Steam forums or on Discord, I'll try to fix it as soon as possible.

Have a good day,
Pierre
